558d2a.title: ICSA Target Map - Attack Surface
558d2a.content:
# ICSA Platform - Attack Surface Map

## Application Overview
Restaurant management SaaS platform. Multi-tenant architecture.
- **Frontend**: https://icsa-web.vercel.app (React/Vite SPA)
- **Backend API**: https://icsa.onrender.com (Node.js, behind Cloudflare)
- JS bundle: `/assets/index-mMXkScxP.js` (290KB)

## API Structure

### Auth Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` → 401 (email+password JSON body)
- `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password` → 401 (requires auth)
- (Possibly: /api/v1/auth/register, /api/v1/auth/forgot-password, /api/v1/auth/refresh)

### Public Endpoints (unauthenticated)
- `GET /api/v1/public/menu` → 404 (needs restaurant ID param?)
- `GET /health` → 200 (health check)
- `GET /readyz` → 200 (readiness check)

### Protected App Endpoints (all → 401 without auth)
- `GET /api/v1/app/dashboard`
- `GET /api/v1/app/dashboard/backup` ← HIGH INTEREST
- `GET /api/v1/app/dashboard/stats`
- `GET /api/v1/app/menu`
- `GET /api/v1/app/menu/categories`
- `GET /api/v1/app/menu/items`
- `GET /api/v1/app/orders`
- `GET /api/v1/app/orders/staff-create`
- `GET /api/v1/app/restaurants`
- `GET /api/v1/app/restaurants/settings`
- `GET /api/v1/app/restaurants/wait-time`
- `GET /api/v1/app/staff`
- `GET /api/v1/app/tables`

### Platform Endpoints (all → 401 without auth)
- `GET /api/v1/platform/restaurants`

## Security Observations
- Rate limiting: 10 requests per 15 minutes on auth endpoints
- CORS: `access-control-allow-origin: https://icsa-web.vercel.app` (strict)
- Auth error: "Invalid email or password" (no user enumeration distinction)
- CSP: strong, default-src 'none'
- HSTS: max-age=31536000
- Behind Cloudflare WAF

## Login Request Format
```json
POST /api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json
{"email":"user@example.com","password":"password"}
```

## Key Vulnerabilities to Test
1. SQLi/NoSQLi on login (email, password fields)
2. Default/common credentials
3. Registration endpoint discovery
4. Public menu IDOR (access other restaurant menus)
5. Backup endpoint (if authenticated)
6. JWT manipulation
7. CORS bypass
8. JS bundle secrets/hardcoded tokens

f2911d.title: ICSA Attack Surface Map — Full Recon Wiki
f2911d.content:
# ICSA Restaurant Platform — Full Attack Surface Map

## Application Overview
- **Type**: Smart restaurant ordering platform (SaaS multi-tenant)
- **Tagline**: "Scan, order, enjoy — the smart restaurant ordering platform"
- **Roles**: PLATFORM_ADMIN, OWNER, MANAGER, WAITER, CASHIER, KITCHEN

---

## Target Infrastructure

### Frontend — https://icsa-web.vercel.app
- **Host**: Vercel CDN
- **Framework**: React 18 (SPA, Vite-built)
- **Router**: React Router v7 (with lazy-loaded chunks)
- **Bundle**: `/assets/index-mMXkScxP.js` (284KB minified, single main bundle)
- **CSS**: `/assets/index-we7A4B58.css`
- **Source maps**: BLOCKED (403 on `.map` files)

### Backend/API — https://icsa.onrender.com
- **Host**: Render.com (behind Cloudflare WAF)
- **Framework**: Node.js / Express (Helmet.js security headers)
- **API base**: `/api/v1`
- **IP**: 216.24.57.7
- **WAF**: Cloudflare detected (nuclei waf-detect)

---

## Tech Stack Fingerprint

### Frontend Headers
```
Server: Vercel
Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload
X-Vercel-Cache: HIT
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *  (static assets)
Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate
```

### Frontend CSP (inline meta tag)
```
default-src 'self';
script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval';
style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
font-src 'self' data:;
img-src 'self' data: blob: res.cloudinary.com;
connect-src 'self' https: http: ws: wss:;
frame-ancestors 'none';
```
**Note**: `unsafe-inline` and `unsafe-eval` allowed — CSP does NOT protect against XSS

### Backend Headers (Helmet.js configured)
```
content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; (strict)
cross-origin-opener-policy: same-origin
cross-origin-resource-policy: same-site
x-content-type-options: nosniff
x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN
x-xss-protection: 0
referrer-policy: no-referrer
strict-transport-security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
x-dns-prefetch-control: off
x-download-options: noopen
x-permitted-cross-domain-policies: none
origin-agent-cluster: ?1
access-control-allow-credentials: true
access-control-expose-headers: X-Request-Id
vary: Origin
```
**Missing**: No `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` gap — all present; good Helmet config

---

## CORS Configuration

### REST API (`/api/v1/*`)
- **Allowed origins**: `https://icsa-web.vercel.app` ONLY (dynamic CORS)
- `access-control-allow-credentials: true`
- Tested evil.com → NO ACAO header (blocked)
- Tested subdomain variants → all blocked
- **HOWEVER**: `Referer: https://icsa-web.vercel.app/` **BYPASSES** the "Missing origin verification" check on `/api/v1/auth/login`

### Socket.io (`/socket.io/`)
- **CORS is permissive**: No `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` returned for cross-origin requests (browser would allow credentialless connections)
- With correct `Origin: https://icsa-web.vercel.app` → returns ACAO header with credentials
- Without origin → open/no restriction in response headers
- **Socket.io is publicly reachable** — no auth on polling endpoint

### Origin Verification Mechanism
- Endpoints like `/api/v1/auth/login` WITHOUT `Origin` header return `{"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"Missing origin verification"}`
- **BYPASS**: Setting `Referer: https://icsa-web.vercel.app/` passes the origin check without the `Origin` header

---

## Authentication & Session System

### Staff/Admin Authentication (JWT Bearer)
- **Login**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` — body: `{email, password}`
  - Requires `Origin: https://icsa-web.vercel.app` OR `Referer` from that origin
  - Rate limit: **10 req / 15 minutes** per IP
  - Returns: `{accessToken, user}` — accessToken stored in memory (not localStorage)
  - User object includes `role`, `mustChangePassword` flag
- **Refresh**: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`
- **Logout**: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`
- **Change Password**: `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`
  - Body: `{currentPassword, newPassword}` (min 12 chars)
  - Staff with `mustChangePassword=true` are redirected to `/staff/password`
- **Auth header**: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`
- **Tab tracking**: `X-Tab-Id` header sent on all authenticated requests (from sessionStorage)

### Guest/Table Session Authentication
- **Create session**: `POST /api/v1/public/table-sessions` — body: `{tableToken}` (min 20 chars)
- **Refresh session**: `POST /api/v1/public/table-sessions/refresh`
- **Rate limit**: 30 req / hour
- Token stored in `sessionStorage` as `rw.session` (key: `rw.session`, `rw.tableToken`, `rw.entered`)
- Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer <sessionToken>` (from `rw.session.sessionToken`)

### Auth Storage
- `accessToken` stored in memory (JS variable `al`) — NOT in localStorage/sessionStorage
- Refresh done automatically on 401 responses
- Table session token stored in sessionStorage

---

## API Endpoints — Full Map

### Public Endpoints (No auth required, table token required for some)
| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/health` | Returns `{"status":"ok","uptimeSeconds":...}` |
| GET | `/readyz` | Returns `{"status":"ready","checks":{"database":"connected"}}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/public/table-sessions` | Create table session, requires tableToken (≥20 chars) |
| POST | `/api/v1/public/table-sessions/refresh` | Refresh session |
| GET | `/api/v1/public/menu` | Menu data (requires valid table session) |
| GET | `/api/v1/public/menu/:id/reviews` | Item reviews |
| POST | `/api/v1/public/orders` | Create order (Idempotency-Key header, paymentMethod: "CASH") |
| GET | `/api/v1/public/orders` | List orders for session |
| GET | `/api/v1/public/orders/:id` | Order status |
| POST | `/api/v1/public/orders/:id/cancel` | Cancel order |
| POST | `/api/v1/public/reviews` | Submit review |
| GET | `/api/v1/public/restaurant/status` | Restaurant open/wait time |

### Auth Endpoints (require Origin/Referer header)
| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/login` | `{email, password}` → JWT |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/refresh` | Refresh access token |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/logout` | Logout |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/change-password` | `{currentPassword, newPassword}` (min 12 chars) |
| GET | `/api/v1/auth/me` | Current user info |

### Authenticated App Endpoints (require staff JWT)
| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/api/v1/app/dashboard/stats` | Dashboard statistics |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/dashboard/backup` | **DATABASE BACKUP DOWNLOAD** — window.location.href redirect |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/menu/categories` | List categories |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/menu/categories` | Create category `{name}` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/menu/categories/:id` | Update category |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/app/menu/categories/:id` | Delete category |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/menu/items` | List menu items |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/menu/images/upload-credentials` | Get cloud upload creds `{kind}` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/menu/items/:id` | Update item |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/menu/items/:id/availability` | Toggle availability `{isAvailable}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/orders` | List orders (params: status, from, to, limit, skip) |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/orders?board=:id` | Board-specific orders |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/orders/staff-create` | Create order as staff (`X-Idempotency-Key` header) |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/orders/:id/transition` | Change order status `{to, expectedCurrentStatus}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/orders/:id/confirm-cash` | Confirm cash payment |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/orders/:id/rush` | Set rush flag `{isRush}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/tables` | List tables |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/tables` | Create table `{label, zone?}` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/tables/:id` | Update table |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/app/tables/:id` | Delete table |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/tables/:id/rotate-token` | Rotate QR token |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/staff` | List staff |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/staff` | Create staff member |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/staff/:id` | Update staff |
| POST | `/api/v1/app/staff/:id/reset-password` | Reset staff password |
| GET | `/api/v1/app/restaurants/settings` | Restaurant settings |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/restaurants/settings` | Update settings |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/app/restaurants/wait-time` | Set wait time `{estimatedWaitMinutes}` |

### Platform Admin Endpoints (require PLATFORM_ADMIN role)
| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants` | List all restaurants |
| POST | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants` | Create restaurant |
| GET | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id` | Get restaurant |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id` | Update restaurant |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/status` | Change status `{status}` |
| POST | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/reset-password` | Reset password |
| GET | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/staff` | List restaurant staff |
| POST | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/staff` | Add staff |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/staff/:staffId` | Update staff |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/staff/:staffId` | Remove staff |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/subscription` | Update subscription |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/features` | Update features `{features}` |
| GET | `/api/v1/platform/analytics` | Platform analytics |
| GET | `/api/v1/platform/audit?limit=60` | Audit log (60 entries) |

---

## Socket.io (Real-time)
- **Endpoint**: `wss://icsa.onrender.com/socket.io/`
- **Protocol**: Socket.io v4 (EIO=4)
- **Transport**: polling → websocket upgrade
- **CORS on Socket.io**: Permissive (no ACAO for cross-origin requests without Origin)
- **Events emitted by client**:
  - `join_restaurant` — with restaurantId (for staff/kitchen views)
  - `join_order` — with orderId (for customer tracking)
- **Connects without credentials** initially

---

## Frontend Routes (React Router)
```
/ → TableEntry (scan QR or enter code)
/t/:token → TableEntry with token (QR scan landing)
/menu → Menu view
/item/:id → Item detail
/cart → Cart
/order/:publicId → Order status
/my-orders → Customer's orders
/staff/login → Staff login page
/staff/password → Force password change
/admin → Admin dashboard
/dashboard → Dashboard
/cashier → Cashier view
/cashier/pos → Cashier POS
/waiter → Waiter view
/waiter/pos → Waiter POS
/kitchen → Kitchen view
/platform → Platform admin
/platform/restaurants → Restaurant management
/platform/analytics → Analytics
```

---

## Key Security Observations

### HIGH PRIORITY for downstream testing
1. **`/api/v1/app/dashboard/backup`** — authenticated backup download endpoint. If auth is bypassable or role check is insufficient, this could expose full DB backup
2. **Origin verification bypass** — `Referer` header substitution works for origin check — potential for CSRF-like bypass
3. **`/api/v1/app/staff/:id/reset-password`** — any authenticated staff can reset another's password? IDOR check needed
4. **`/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/reset-password`** — platform admin can reset restaurant owner passwords
5. **`/api/v1/app/menu/images/upload-credentials`** — returns cloud storage credentials (Cloudinary). Could expose upload keys
6. **Socket.io `join_restaurant`** — any client can join any restaurant's real-time channel without auth?
7. **`/api/v1/app/orders/:id/transition`** — order state machine transitions; test for workflow bypasses
8. **`mustChangePassword` flag** — staff accounts with temporary passwords; test if default/weak passwords accepted
9. **`/api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/features`** — can modify feature flags for any restaurant (IDOR if accessible to non-platform-admin)
10. **Table token rotation** — `/api/v1/app/tables/:id/rotate-token` — can staff rotate competitor table tokens?

### Rate Limiting
- Login: 10 req / 900s (15 min) per IP
- Table session creation: 30 req / 3600s (1 hour) per IP
- General API: 200 req / 60s

### Idempotency Keys
- `POST /api/v1/app/orders/staff-create` requires `X-Idempotency-Key` header
- `POST /api/v1/public/orders` requires `Idempotency-Key` header (different casing)

### No Open API Docs
- No swagger/openapi/graphql introspection — all return 404

---

## Cookies / Auth Tokens
- No `Set-Cookie` headers observed during login testing (401 responses)
- Auth tokens stored in memory (Bearer) or sessionStorage (guest)
- `rw.session` key in sessionStorage = guest session token object
- `rw.tableToken` = table QR token stored in sessionStorage
- `rw.tab_id` = random tab identifier in sessionStorage

---

## Image Storage
- Images served from `res.cloudinary.com`
- Upload credentials fetched via `POST /api/v1/app/menu/images/upload-credentials`

372ed0.title: ICSA — High-Priority Attack Vectors for Downstream Agents
372ed0.content:
# High-Priority Targets for Vulnerability Testing Agents

Based on recon, the following are the highest-value attack vectors to investigate:

## CRITICAL PRIORITY

### 1. IDOR on Staff Password Reset
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/app/staff/:id/reset-password`
- **Attack**: Authenticated staff member (any role) calls this with another staff member's ID
- **Expected finding**: Privilege escalation / account takeover if role check is missing

### 2. IDOR on Order Operations
- **Endpoints**: 
  - `POST /api/v1/public/orders/:id/cancel` — can customer cancel another customer's order?
  - `GET /api/v1/public/orders/:id` — can customer view another customer's order?
  - `POST /api/v1/app/orders/:id/transition` — can WAITER role transition orders they don't own?
- **Attack**: Enumerate order IDs (UUIDs or sequential?) and access cross-tenant orders

### 3. Dashboard Backup Endpoint
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/v1/app/dashboard/backup`
- **Attack**: 
  - Is backup accessible to ALL authenticated staff or only OWNER/PLATFORM_ADMIN?
  - Role-based access: WAITER/CASHIER/KITCHEN roles should NOT access backups
  - URL: `https://icsa.onrender.com/api/v1/app/dashboard/backup`
  - The frontend uses `window.location.href` redirect (browser download)

### 4. Upload Credentials Exposure
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/app/menu/images/upload-credentials`
- **Attack**: What role is required? Are credentials scoped? Can credentials be reused for arbitrary uploads?
- **Body**: `{kind: "..."}`  — what kinds are valid?

### 5. Origin Verification Bypass with Referer
- **Finding**: `Referer: https://icsa-web.vercel.app/` header bypasses the "Missing origin verification" check
- **Impact**: Allows CSRF-like requests from malicious pages with a controlled Referer (older browsers / some server-side setups) — needs validation

## HIGH PRIORITY

### 6. Platform Admin IDOR — Feature/Subscription Flags
- **Endpoints**: `PATCH /api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id/features` and `/subscription`
- **Attack**: Can an OWNER-role user modify their own restaurant's subscription/features by guessing these endpoints?

### 7. Socket.io Unauthorized Join
- **Endpoint**: `wss://icsa.onrender.com/socket.io/`
- **Events**: `join_restaurant <restaurantId>`, `join_order <orderId>`
- **Attack**: Can any unauthenticated client join any restaurant's real-time channel and see live order data?

### 8. Auth Brute Force / Account Enumeration
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
- **Rate limit**: 10/900s — slow but feasible
- **Attack**: Does the error message differ for wrong email vs wrong password? (enumeration)
- **Current observation**: Error is always `"Invalid email or password"` — good, but verify

### 9. Table Token Prediction
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/v1/public/table-sessions`  
- **Attack**: If table tokens are predictable (not random enough), attacker can impersonate tables
- **Note**: Min 20 chars required

### 10. Order Idempotency Key Abuse
- **Header**: `X-Idempotency-Key` on staff order creation
- **Attack**: Can the same idempotency key be replayed? Can it be empty?

## MEDIUM PRIORITY

### 11. Mass Assignment on Staff/Restaurant Updates
- **Endpoints**: `PATCH /api/v1/app/staff/:id`, `PATCH /api/v1/platform/restaurants/:id`
- **Attack**: Send extra fields like `role`, `restaurantId`, `isActive`, `subscription` in the body

### 12. mustChangePassword Flag Bypass
- **Finding**: Staff with `mustChangePassword=true` are redirected frontend-only
- **Attack**: After login, use the accessToken directly against API endpoints without changing password — is the API also enforcing this check?

## API Auth Requirements Summary
- `Origin: https://icsa-web.vercel.app` OR `Referer: https://icsa-web.vercel.app/` required for auth endpoints
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for all /app/* and /platform/* endpoints
- Table session bearer token for /public/* endpoints (after session creation)

cb6b1d.title: Auth & Injection Testing — Methodology & Findings
cb6b1d.content:
## Auth & Injection Testing — ICSA Platform

**Target:** https://icsa.onrender.com

### Status
Testing was significantly hampered by render.com free-tier cold starts. The service took >60s to respond on initial requests, causing test scripts to time out before producing output. No confirmed vulnerabilities were validated due to inability to get reliable responses within the time budget.

### Endpoints Planned for Testing
- POST /api/v1/auth/login (rate-limited: 10 req / 15 min)
- POST /api/v1/auth/register
- POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password
- POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password
- GET  /api/v1/auth/me
- POST /api/v1/auth/refresh

### Tests Prepared (not completed due to service unresponsiveness)
1. NoSQL injection: `{"email":{"$ne":"invalid"},"password":{"$ne":"invalid"}}` etc.
2. SQL injection: `admin'--`, `OR '1'='1` etc.
3. Default credentials: admin@icsa.com/admin123, demo@icsa.com/demo, etc.
4. Mass assignment on /register: adding `"role":"admin"` to registration body
5. CORS: testing evil.com, null origin, subdomain bypass
6. Method tampering: PUT/PATCH/DELETE on auth endpoints

### No Confirmed Vulnerabilities
No tokens, no successful logins, no injection confirmation — service was cold/unresponsive.

- Menu, ItemDetail, Cart, MyOrders, OrderStatus

## High-Priority Security Observations

1. **`/api/v1/app/dashboard/backup`** — triggered via `window.location.href` redirect (GET). If not properly auth-gated this could expose a full database backup file.
2. **`/app/menu/images/upload-credentials`** — returns cloud storage upload credentials. If these are S3/GCS presigned credentials with broad permissions, this is a significant finding.
3. **`/app/tables/${id}/rotate-token`** — rotating table QR tokens; if IDOR exists, attacker can invalidate legitimate customer sessions.
4. **`/platform/audit?limit=60`** — audit log; hardcoded limit suggests possible manipulation via query param.
5. **JWT stored in-memory** (`al` variable) — not in localStorage, good practice. But token refresh via POST `/auth/refresh` using cookies (`credentials: "include"`) — CSRF risk on refresh endpoint.
6. **No hardcoded API keys or secrets** found in the bundle.
